name: @excalimate/share-worker
description: Cloudflare Worker for E2E encrypted animation sharing

scripts.lifecycle:apply: npm run lifecycle:apply:current && npm run lifecycle:apply:legacy
scripts.lifecycle:apply:current: wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle set excalimate-shares-v2 --file ./r2-lifecycle.json --config ./wrangler.jsonc
scripts.lifecycle:apply:legacy: wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle set excalimate-shares --file ./r2-lifecycle.json --config ./wrangler.jsonc
